message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the loaded data (X, Y) or on the function parameters before they are used.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded via local filesystem helpers (get_data_dataset, imread, VideoCapture) with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks for any remote source.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, label value validation, or label-noise detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) is used anywhere in the visible code.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering is applied to the training samples before model fitting.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads a model via `model.load_model(fname_in)` and downloads VGG19 weights via `VGG19(weights='imagenet', ...)` without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to confirm integrity.
No detected label distribution validation: The code loads data and splits it into train/test sets without any class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomaly detection on labels.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses a standard Keras/Adam optimizer with no DP-SGD, TensorFlow Privacy, or Opacus integration.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or manual FGSM/PGD perturbation logic are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although a train/test split is performed, the test set is not cryptographically hashed or isolated, only a single accuracy metric is reported, and there is no protection against leakage (e.g., the model uses validation_split on the training portion while the same data pipeline feeds both splits).
No detected input sanitization: The inference path (model.predict) receives data directly from data.get_data_dataset with no shape, range, or schema validation before passing it to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: Predictions from model.predict are passed directly to model.accuracy without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a CNN-based image classification model, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
